title.en: Longtime groomers with honest coat advice

text.en: Most dog owners praise groomers Victoria, Austin, and Katherine at this Preston Road salon for their friendly service and honest coat care advice, such as explaining why double-coated breeds should not be shaved. However, one longtime client reported a rude phone call with the owner over a deposit policy.

title.en: Thorough dog grooms and hydrotherapy baths

text.en: Dog owners consistently praise the grooming quality, highlighting neat breed cuts on Cairn Terriers and Aussies, thorough brush-outs for heavy shedding, short nail clipping, and skin-exfoliating hydrotherapy baths. In contrast, one cat owner was deeply unhappy, alleging unwashed tools caused a ringworm infection.

title.en: Attentive care for dogs of varied temperaments

text.en: Many longtime clients trust the team with multiple dogs over the years, noting that even challenging pets are well cared for and come home happy. While one cat owner reported a serious health issue after a visit, dog owners consistently say their pets enjoy seeing their groomers.

q.en: Are appointments required at Knot 2 Shaggy?

a.en: Yes, the salon works by appointment, though one reviewer noted being accommodated on short notice for a birthday groom.

q.en: Does Knot 2 Shaggy require a booking deposit?

a.en: According to client feedback, the salon charges a deposit if a dog has not visited within the past six to eight weeks.

q.en: What special bathing and care services are available?

a.en: In addition to standard baths, breed haircuts, brush-outs, and nail clipping, clients mention upgrading to hydrotherapy baths for skin exfoliation, as well as overnight kennel boarding.

q.en: How do clients describe the grooming prices at Knot 2 Shaggy?

a.en: Opinions are mixed: several regular clients consider the pricing fair and worth the cost, while others find the rates steep or note a deposit requirement.
